# Should you file an 83(b) election on your vesting stock?

> Free 83(b) election calculator for founders and startup employees with vesting stock. See tax due at grant, tax at each vest date, the break-even sale value, the tax wasted if you leave early, and your 30-day deadline. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
